question: Who became Indian Navy's first woman fighter pilot streamer on 3 July 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aastha Poonia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Aastha Poonia** became the Indian Navy's first woman fighter pilot on **3 July 2025**.
 
• She trained at the **Indian Naval Air Squadron** (INAS) for operating advanced fighter jets.
 
• Aastha Poonia is part of a significant milestone in Indian armed forces, symbolizing **gender inclusivity** in combat roles.
 
• This achievement follows the Indian Navy’s decision to allow women in combat aviation roles in **2020**.
 
• As a fighter pilot, she will operate cutting-edge platforms such as the **MiG-29K and other naval aircraft**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Women in Indian Armed Forces:**

 
 
• Women were first inducted in non-medical roles in the **Indian Armed Forces** in 1992.
 
• The Indian Air Force started inducting women as fighter pilots in **2016**.
 
 
 
• **Combat Roles for Women:**
 
 
• Combat roles for women have been a **gradual policy shift** in India.
 
• It signifies the armed forces' move towards **gender neutrality**.
 
 
 
• **MiG-29K Aircraft:**
 
 
• The MiG-29K is a fourth-generation, multirole fighter aircraft used by the Indian Navy.
 
• It is capable of operating from aircraft carriers and conducting air-to-air and air-to-surface missions.
 
 
 
• **Indian Naval Air Squadron (INAS):**
 
 
• INAS is the naval aviation arm responsible for training and deploying naval aviation personnel.
 
• It plays a key role in maintaining the operational readiness of the Indian Navy’s air fleet.
